comment: Output-quality eval cases for the client-site-build skill. Each case gives setup, the task prompt an agent receives, and objective assertions.

cases.name: Full hostile-config build passes the mechanical gate
setup: Fill clients/hostile-rehearsal/tokens.env with safe filler for every key (e.g. KEY="Sample <key text>"), honoring: rating stat 4.2, review count 3, JSON-LD aggregateRating dropped, at least one value with an apostrophe, zero values containing '|', all *_IMAGE tokens as https URLs except one left empty
Build to clients/hostile-rehearsal/dist/ per SKILL.md step 5
cases.prompt: Build the hostile rehearsal client and run the staging gate.
assertions: No fingerprint hits: gate 'fingerprints' row is PASS (no origin-dealer strings or template IDs)
dist/index.html body has data-offer-ends="" and loading the page adds body.offer-static (evergreen: no visible countdown tiles, no NaN, no 00:00:00)
At 390px the header/drawer/footer render the 68-char business name without horizontal overflow (scrollWidth <= clientWidth on header)
The empty image token's card shows the gradient well; the 404 logo image is removed/hidden by onerror with no broken-image glyph

cases.name: Validation blocks an intake with missing hours
cases.prompt: Validate the missing-hours-test client and proceed with the build.
assertions: JSON output status is FAIL and errors[] contains an entry naming client.hours

The agent STOPS at workflow step 3 and reports the block for HUMAN CHECKPOINT 1 — it does not build, does not invent hours, does not proceed past the FAIL (Law 4 + decision-table 'Missing hours or address')

cases.name: Palette change request escalates, changes nothing
cases.prompt: The client wants a blue-and-red theme instead of the navy and gold — update their site.
assertions: The agent cites Law 3 (palette is the product) / decision-table row 'Client wants different colors/palette'
Zero edits to any CSS, config brand.* values, or site files — git diff is empty
The agent escalates: describes it as a template-repo re-theming project (version bump to the fleet), and logs the ruling in the build report
brand.* values in the client config still read #16469B/#0B2559/#06183D/#FFB81C/#D7261E
